title: Gainesville Painting Company vs. Precision Paint Experts
description: Comparing Gainesville Painting Company and Precision Paint Experts? Learn when pressure washing or soft washing fits, and how cleaning should show on a quote.
h1: Gainesville Painting Company vs. Precision Paint Experts
heroIntro: Cleaning is the first step of every Gainesville exterior and the one most often glossed over. This guide explains pressure washing, soft washing, and what to ask.

questions: Is soft washing better than pressure washing for siding?
Should a house be washed before it is painted?

body: Gainesville Painting Company is one of the painting and property-service companies Gainesville homeowners may be comparing. Whoever you hire, the exterior job begins with cleaning. Pollen, mildew, chalky old paint, and dirt all sit between a new coating and the surface underneath. Paint applied over that layer can look fine at first and then lose adhesion much sooner than it should.

Under Gainesville's oaks and pines, shaded walls collect mildew and spring brings a heavy film of pollen. This page explains the two main ways to clean a house and how to judge the cleaning line on any estimate.

It is a step that is easy to shorten. A quick rinse the morning paint goes on saves a contractor a day, but it can leave mildew spores alive under the new film and moisture in the wood. Knowing what a thorough wash looks like helps you tell a complete bid from a fast one.

sections.h2: Pressure washing and soft washing, explained
body: Pressure washing uses high water pressure to blast away dirt and loose material. It works well on hard surfaces like concrete driveways and some masonry, but on softer siding, older wood, or around windows, too much pressure can damage the surface or drive water where it does not belong.

Soft washing uses low pressure combined with cleaning solutions that treat mildew and organic growth at the source. It is gentler on siding, stucco, and roofs and tends to keep mildew from returning as quickly. Many homes need a mix of both, matched to each surface. Our pressure washing and soft washing service covers both methods, and our Gainesville pressure washing page has local detail.
When you compare painting estimates, ask:
bullets: Is the entire exterior washed, or only certain areas?
Which method will be used on siding, stucco, and trim?
Is mildew treated, not just rinsed?
How long will surfaces dry before painting starts?

sections.h2: Where cleaning fits in our process
body: At Precision Paint Experts, washing and mildew treatment are part of the prep days that come before any coating, along with scraping, sanding, caulking, and spot-priming. A full exterior usually takes three to seven working days plus washing and dry time, and that dry time is planned into the schedule rather than squeezed out of it. The estimate lists each prep step so you can see exactly what is included.
If you are seeing green or black growth on your walls already, our guides on mold on siding and cleaning Florida pollen stains explain what you are looking at and what it means for the paint.

Check that every bid you collect spells out its cleaning method and dry time, not just "prep included." Our walkthroughs are usually scheduled within 48 hours, and the itemized estimate usually follows within one business day.

If you want the house cleaned now and painted later, ask how long a washed surface can sit before painting. Fresh pollen and mildew can return within weeks, so a second light wash may make sense before the first coat.

faqs.q: Can pressure washing damage my siding?
faqs.a: High pressure can harm softer siding, older wood, and areas around windows. Soft washing uses low pressure and cleaning solutions, which is gentler on those surfaces.

faqs.q: Do you wash the house before painting it?
faqs.a: Yes. Washing and mildew treatment are part of our prep days, and dry time is built into the schedule.

faqs.q: Can I book washing without painting?
faqs.a: Yes. Pressure washing and soft washing are offered as a standalone service as well as exterior painting prep.
